ChunkDefCopy.description:
One `Chunk_Table` 16-word chunk-definition copy (`source_chunk` ->
`dest_chunk`) resolved to every `(chunk_x, chunk_y)` cell on this map that
references `dest_chunk` (`MapDataMan_Dezolis` `loc_525AC` /
`Event_EclipseTorchUsed` `$07041E`, `#676`).

event_flag.description: Event bank bit index that activates this copy on map load, when set.

tiles.description:
Every map chunk referencing `dest_chunk` on FG or BG, with its post-copy
collision cells and composed patch-atlas tile index.

ConveyorGroup.description:
One group of conveyor belt chunks sharing a direction toggle and 8-frame
chunk-id table (`MapUpdate_VahFortConveyorBelts` `$11` /
`MapUpdate_WpnPlntConveyorBelts` `$12`).

chunks.description: Foreground chunk coordinates `(chunk_x, chunk_y)` written in `Map_Layout_FG`.

frames_clear.description:
8-entry chunk-id table indexed by `Main_Frame_Count & 7` when `temp_flag`
is absent or clear.

frames_set.description:
8-entry chunk-id table indexed by `Main_Frame_Count & 7` when `temp_flag`
is set.

temp_flag.description:
Optional temporary event flag (`$0B`/`$0C` or `$11`/`$12`) selecting
`frames_set` over `frames_clear`.

EffectGate.description: One flag condition on an effect path.

bank.description: `event_flags` or `chest_flags` — the only banks retail gates on.

flag.description: The flag id within the bank.

symbol.description: The disassembly's name, when it has one.

EffectPath.description: One execution route through an effect routine.

aborts_remaining_entries.description:
The dormant dispatcher abort: a routine returning non-zero skips the
rest of the map's list. No retail routine sets it.

deferred.description: Recognised-but-not-modelled instructions stepped over on this path.

deferred_effects.description: Decoded palette copies with their already-extracted NPC sheet variants.

gates.description: Flag conditions that must all hold for this path to run.

unconditional.description: True when the path has no gates — it runs on every load.

EffectWrite.description:
One write a path performs. Kind-specific fields are optional so one type
covers the union; the `kind` string is authoritative.

at.description: ROM address of the writing instruction.

bank.description:
The flag bank label, for `flag_clear` (the door the routine calls;
"chest_flags"/"temp_flags" both name the $F140 temp door).

cells.description:
Per-cell collision resolution: always exactly 4 cells in
`(0,0) (1,0) (0,1) (1,1)` order, absolute coordinates.

collision_authoritative.description:
Whether this write's plane is the one collision reads on this map
(276 retail maps read BG, 83 FG). `false` means picture-only: the
patch tile still draws, the cells never touch the grid.

flag.description: The flag id within the bank, for `flag_clear`.

object_index.description: Record object index, for the object kinds.

patch_tile.description:
Index into the map's [`PatchTiles`](crate::map::PatchTiles) atlas for
this write's chunk.

source.description:
The replacement layout's ROM source, for `layout_replace` — matches a
[`LayoutVariant`](crate::LayoutVariant) plane source.

InteractionAreaPatch.description:
One map interaction area.

The ROM stores an 8-pixel source coordinate and an `XYRangeJmpTbl` index.
The pack resolves both into the same 16-pixel collision-cell rectangle the
runtime uses for landing checks, while retaining the raw bytes for audit.

event_index.description: `Interaction_GetEvent`'s resolved Event_Index, when this is type 2.

flag_type.description: Which flag bank the interaction handler uses for its record flag.

name.description: Extractor's name, when the byte is one of the retail selectors.

index.description: Position in this map's interaction-area list.

interaction_type.description: Index into the retail interaction-handler table.

name.description: The disassembly's name for it, such as `XYExact`.

rect.description: A half-open rectangle of collision cells: `x..x + width`.

width.description: Width in cells. The packer never emits zero; it emits no rectangle.

source.description: The raw coordinate and its standing-cell resolution.

x_byte.description: Raw X word from the record, in 8-pixel units.

x_cell.description: Collision-grid column after dividing the raw X by two.

y_byte.description:
Raw Y word from the record, in 8-pixel units and one row above the
occupied collision cell after resolution.

y_cell.description:
Collision-grid row after dividing raw Y by two and applying the
standing-cell shift.

LayoutVariant.description: A whole-layout replacement, decoded like a base layout.

planes.description: Per-plane provenance: which plane changed and its ROM source.

png_over.description: The variant's priority overlay, when it has priority tiles.

vehicle_battle.description:
The variant's raw chunk grid, when its layout can feed vehicle battle
background selection.

MapEffect.description: One `MapDataManager` jump-table entry as it applies to this map.

decoded.description:
Whether the decoder fully decoded the routine. `false` entries carry
`reason` instead of paths and a consumer must treat the map as
possibly incompletely patched.

kinds.description: The write kinds this entry produces, for census-level checks.

paths.description: Execution paths, each with the exact gate conditions that reach it.

reason.description: Why decoding stopped, when `decoded` is false.

MapUpdatePatch.description: One table entry, bound in the map's cartridge order.

index.description: Byte index in the 64-entry jump table.

program.description: Decoded operation and its extracted inputs.

oneOf.description: Retail `moveq #0,d0; rts`.
Conditional palette table copies.

bypass.description: Reunion can bypass the shutdown gates.

cycles.description: Independent clocks, evaluated in cartridge order.

gates.description: All gates must hold unless bypass is set.

stopped.description: Literal writes on the stopped branch, if any.

oneOf.description: Camera-step damping: `step -= step ASR shift`.
Zio tunnels' sparse horizontal-scroll writes and BG X ASR 2.
Sine-based scroll table writes.
Rykros countdown, flash sequence and RNG2 reload.

colors.description: Four flash words from the cartridge table.

oneOf.description: Chest predicates feeding a base event, or the unused chest clear.

clear_chest.description: Clear a chest rather than set an event.

oneOf.description: The Edge clears fourteen words, then rotates five extracted colors.
The Edge's per-map palette blob reads.

frames.description: Resolved backdrop and fourteen line-1 writes per phase.

sliding.description: Two-byte sliding window rather than 28-byte records.

oneOf.description: Ladea/Air Castle saved sound and secondary-map word writes.
Random_Battles_Flag from the leader's current Y pixel word.

y_max.description: Disabled at and below this unsigned word.

oneOf.description: Ping-pong tile DMA from RAM_Start staging frames (`MapUpdate_GaruberkTowerPart4`, `$22`).

frame_count.description: Number of staged frames in the ping-pong sequence (`3`: `0..=2`).

gates.description: Temp/event/chest gates that must all hold (`temp $15` and `temp $17` clear).

oneOf.description:
Conveyor-belt foreground chunk animation (`MapUpdate_VahFortConveyorBelts` `$11`,
`MapUpdate_WpnPlntConveyorBelts` `$12`).

groups.description: Ordered groups of foreground chunks and their 8-frame tables.

oneOf.description:
Input the runtime does not represent: a known routine whose required
native buffer/subsystem is absent. The decoder reports it rather than
guessing its effect.

NpcPatch.description: A field object: townsfolk, guards, the ones that just stand there.

art_tile.description: First VRAM tile of the object's art.

camera_bypass.description:
Whether the object's type sets render-flags bit 0, bypassing both
camera-plane subtractions in `FieldObj_CalcSpritePos`.

dialogue_id.description: Index into this map's dialogue tree.

id.description: The raw byte: 0 down, 4 up, 8 right, `$C` left.

oneOf.description: Facing down the screen; the raw byte is 0.
Raw byte 4.
Raw byte 8.
Raw byte `$C`.

index.description: Position in this map's object list.

interactable.description:
Whether the object's type sets render-flags bit 3 (`$2(a3)`), which
the cartridge tests before BOTH the talk probe and object collision.
A `false` here is a monster you can see, not speak to, and walk
straight through. Defaults `true` for packs predating the field.

object_id.description: Byte offset into `FieldObjectsJmpTbl`; the object's behaviour routine.

record_offset.description: Where the record sits in the ROM.

sprite.description: An object's binding to a sprite sheet.

facing.description: A sprite facing, tolerating the cartridge's one out-of-set byte.

oneOf.description: Facing down.
Facing up.
Facing left.
Facing right.
A facing byte outside {0, 4, 8, $C}; drawn as down.

sheet.description: Sheet id inside the index file named by `sheets`.

sprite_reason.description:
Why this object has no sprite (invisible trigger, vehicle-gated art,
...) when `sprite` is `None`. Exactly one of the two is set.

x_cell.description:
Column, in cells.

`LoadMapObjects` places objects with `lsl.w #3`, so object coordinates
are in 8-pixel units and 85 of the cartridge's 949 objects sit on a half
cell. This is the floor -- the cell the object's collision reads from --
and for those 85 it is lossy. [`Npc::x_pixels`] and [`Npc::y_pixels`]
are the authoritative placement; prefer them for rendering, and use the
cell for collision and lookup.

Chests and transitions are not like this: they store bytes already
scaled by 16, so their cell is the stored byte with no division.

x_pixels.description: X in pixels, as the record stores it.

y_cell.description: Row, in cells, with the standing-cell shift applied.

y_pixels.description: Y in pixels, as the record stores it.

OverworldLayoutPatch.description: One raw paged-overworld hook, in page-loader order.

event_flag.description: Event flag tested by the hook.

routine.description: ROM routine address, retained for provenance.

triggered_by_plane.description: Plane whose page copy invokes the hook (`fg` or `bg`).

writes.description: Stores into the rolling layout window, resolved to world coordinates.

displacement.description: Displacement from the page hook's layout pointer.

patch_tile.description: Entry in `patch_tiles`, whose PNG holds the composed FG/BG picture.

PaletteAffectedSprites.description: The NPC assets affected by a palette copy. Map pixels use other CRAM lines.

npc_sheets.description: Replacements retain the object's movement and dialogue identity.

PaletteCycle.description: One independently clocked set of palette writes.

frames.description: Exact table reads, with source displacements already resolved.

phase.description: How the table phase is selected.

timer.description: Use preincremented $ECF2 as clock instead of Main_Frame_Count.

affects.description: Sprite replacements produced with the copied palette.

The CRAM line the copy fills: `Palette_Table_Buffer + $20 * line`.

PalettePhase.description: Phase selection for a palette table.

oneOf.description: `(Main_Frame_Count & mask) >> shift`.

oneOf.description: A wrapping byte counter, reset on reaching the extracted table length.

PaletteSpriteReplacement.description: One NPC's base sheet and the variant baked with the copied CRAM words.

from.description: Base sheet expected by the extraction record.

npc_index.description: Index in the map's object list.

to.description: Sheet to draw when the enclosing path's gates hold.

bg_chunk_id.description: BG member of a composed overworld tile.

chunk_id.description:
Raw chunk id for a one-plane `MapDataManager`/scene tile; absent for a
composed overworld FG/BG tile, which is not a raw chunk.

collision.description:
Row-major 2x2 collision values for live scene writes. Older atlases

fg_chunk_id.description: FG member of a composed overworld tile.

index.description: Position in the atlas row; `x` is its pixel offset.

priority_tiles.description: How many of the tile's 8px cells carry the priority bit.

ResolvedCell.description: A resolved collision cell for a `layout_write`.

collision.description: The 4-bit collision type the written chunk imposes.

Sign extension and ASR, the unused vertical scroll entry.

Byte 3 is a meseta count, in hundreds.

item_symbol.description: The item's symbol, when it holds an item.

meseta.description:
Set when `contents_type` is [`ContentsType::Meseta`]. Already multiplied

record_offset.description: Where the record sits in the ROM.

sprite.description: An object's binding to a sprite sheet.

facing.description: A sprite facing, tolerating the cartridge's one out-of-set byte.

Facing up.

A facing byte outside {0, 4, 8, $C}; drawn as down.

white_chest.description: Whether this is one of the white chests.

Extended events/chests, $F120.

True when the "replacement" is the map's own base blob (one plane of

WarpPatch.description:
A map transition.

The ROM stores a source coordinate and an `XYRangeJmpTbl` index, not a
rectangle; the packer transcribes the fifteen routines into [`Warp::rect`]
and clips it to the map, because five of them are open-ended half-planes.

Raw byte 4.
Raw byte 8.

source.description: The record's coordinate, raw and resolved.

description: Sparse JSON patch schema for `patches/maps/<id>_<symbol>.json`, generated from `psiv-data` Rust types with strict unknown-field rejection (`additionalProperties: false`).

art_cycle_images.description:
Original PNG (base, variant, or priority overlay) -> ordered per-frame
PNGs for tile-DMA art cycles (`[frame0, frame1, ...]`, where frame 0 is
the key itself). Palette-index counterparts live in `map_update_images`.

chunk_def_copies.description:
Resolved `Chunk_Table` 16-word chunk-definition copies applied live by
scenes and on flagged map loads (e.g. Dezolis Eclipse Torch `$08 -> $4B`).

collision.description: The collision grid and the plane it came from.

plane.description:
Which plane the collision was read from.

`GetChunkAndCollision` reads `Map_Layout_BG` when the map record's
`$FFFFEC24` byte is non-zero and `Map_Layout_FG` when it is zero.

oneOf.description: Foreground plane.
Background plane.

rows.description: Collision rows: each row is either a hex-nibble string or an array of 4-bit collision codes (0..=15).

dialogue_tree.description: Which of the 43 dialogue trees this map's objects speak from, `1..=43`.

dimensions.description: Size, in cells, chunks and pixels.

cell_pixels.description:
Always [`COLLISION_CELL_PIXELS`]; carried so the pack is readable on its
own and so a drift in the packer is caught rather than assumed away.

width_cells.description:
Width in collision cells. This is the coordinate space of everything
else in the record.

width_chunks.description: Width in chunks; a chunk is 4x4 tiles, so 2x2 cells.

width_pixels.description: Width in pixels, for the renderer.

events.description:
`RunEventsJmpTbl` trigger indices in evaluation order (`[0]` is the
retail idle case — no map carries an empty list).

dungeon_teleport_index.description:
Which dungeon-teleport destination this map belongs to.

`None` when the stored byte has bit 7 set, which the extractor reads as
an inherited index: map load skips the store. Nine retail maps do this: the
eight `ValleyMaze*` parts and `Passageway`.

poison.description: Non-zero on maps that drain HP as the party walks.

town_teleport.description: Non-zero blocks town teleport. Zero still requires no dungeon exit.

format_version.description:
The pack format this record was written in. Repeated per map so a single
file is self-describing.

interaction_areas.description:
Areas checked by `Interaction_ChkMapAreas`, in record order.  Packs
emitted before interaction extraction may omit this field.

oneOf.description: Sparse ID-keyed patch map keyed by `index`.
Array of partial record patches, each carrying `index`.

layout_patches.description:
Original overworld page-hook records. They are kept separate from
`MapDataManager` and from their render/collision resolution below.

layout_variants.description:
Decoded whole-layout replacements referenced by `layout_replace`
writes, shipped as first-class variants with their own collision.

map_effects.description:
`MapDataManager` entries for this map: flag-gated load-time patches
(`docs/field/MAP_EFFECTS.md`). Absent on packs predating the extraction.

map_update_images.description: Original PNG -> additive palette-index PNG (including variants/atlases).

map_update_palette.description: Initial 64-word CRAM shadow, including the fixed party line.

map_updates.description: Ordered per-frame programs. None is a legacy pack, not an empty list.

oneOf.description: Sparse ID-keyed patch map keyed by `index`.
Array of partial record patches, each carrying `index`.

changes_music.description: False when the id is 0 and the current track keeps playing.

id.description: The music id as the map record stores it.

oneOf.description: Sparse ID-keyed patch map keyed by `index`.
Array of partial record patches, each carrying `index`.

overworld_patches.description:
Flag-selected, composed page-hook results for this full-map build.
Retail also replays hooks when a page streams mid-map; this record does
not claim to model a flag changing while the same map remains loaded.

patch_tiles.description: A map's patch-tile atlas: raw chunks and composed overworld plane pairs.

count.description: How many tiles the atlas holds.

png.description: The atlas PNG, one row of tiles.

png_over.description:
The above-sprites overlay atlas. An overworld has one even if its
composed results contain no priority pixels, to erase stale base ones.

tile_pixels.description: Tile edge length in pixels (32: a chunk is 2x2 collision cells).

tiles.description: Raw tiles first by chunk id, then composed FG/BG pairs by ids.

png.description: The composed render, relative to the pack directory.

png_over.description:
The priority-tile overlay render (tiles the VDP draws above sprites),
or `None` for the 22 maps with zero priority tiles.

scroll.description: The map-load camera bytes and optional initial 16.16 step counters.

bg_scroll_word.description: Original background word, retained for extraction provenance.

bg_step_counters.description:
The two longwords that `loc_51AB2` can seed as camera step counters.

The pack keeps the ROM's eight-digit hexadecimal spelling because these
are 16.16 signed longwords, not pixel counts. Runtime code parses them at
the camera boundary and rejects no information by narrowing them to words.

fg_scroll_word.description: Original foreground word, retained for extraction provenance.

fg_step_counters.description:
The two longwords that `loc_51AB2` can seed as camera step counters.

The pack keeps the ROM's eight-digit hexadecimal spelling because these
are 16.16 signed longwords, not pixel counts. Runtime code parses them at
the camera boundary and rejects no information by narrowing them to words.

mode.description: Global sprite-plane selector, `$EC24` (`0` foreground, nonzero background).

padding_byte.description: The skipped byte between `$EC24` and the foreground word.

oneOf.description: Sparse ID-keyed patch map keyed by `index`.
Array of partial record patches, each carrying `index`.

vehicle_battle.description: Raw chunk ids in the collision-authoritative layout plane.

plane.description: `fg` or `bg`, matching the decoded map plane.

warps.description: Map transitions from both tables, in record order.

oneOf.description: Sparse ID-keyed patch map keyed by `index`.
Array of partial record patches, each carrying `index`.
